label: early-position (step 3) update gate, token-modulated
explanation: Strictly positional: active only at steps t=2..4 and never in the copy phase or at t<=1 or t>=5. 76% of activation mass is at t=3 (either the 4th original token or the <DEL> when L=3), 17% at t=2, 6% at t=4. Within that window only ~40% of steps fire; which ones depends on prefix contents (higher when n, z, h, u, o occurred earlier and on first occurrences of the input token; repeated tokens rarely fire), but no simple token set improved F1. Largest activations are at <DEL> for L=3 sequences whose prefix contains n/z followed by h/u. Predicate t==3 gets dev F1 0.51, mass recall 0.76; the window t in 2..4 gives recall 1.0 but precision 0.22.
